summary: onCompletionSelect returning true now also removes the typed trigger and query when the handler put text or a pill before them; when the text became ambiguous nothing is removed.
howTo: Nothing to change. A handler that worked around the leftover trigger (for example by deleting '#query' itself after setText or insertMention before it) can drop that workaround. After a rebuild the SDK removes the trigger text only when it occurs exactly once as a whole word (so '#bug-7' put in for '#bu' is never cut); when it occurs more than once it removes nothing, so the handler keeps control of the text.
